##### Project general facts

The One by Prestige One Developments is a striking commercial landmark created for modern businesses, combining sophisticated design with practical functionality. The project offers premium office spaces designed to create an inspiring and professional environment, with open layouts that support creativity, collaboration, and productivity.

The One provides an exceptional collection of amenities designed to make the working day more comfortable, productive, and enjoyable, including a Prestige Fitness Centre, Business Lounge, Wellness Centre, Prestige Cafe, Sky Lounge, virtual golf studio, botanical garden, meeting and conference rooms, and library lounges. Wellness facilities such as a pool, spa pool, jacuzzi, ice bath, rainforest shower, and changing suites add an impressive focus on relaxation and well-being, while valet service, concierge assistance, 24-hour security, and a skyline terrace provide an elevated experience.

The interiors are designed in a sleek, modern style with timeless elegance, combining open spaces with sophisticated details and premium finishes. The lobby features carefully selected seating and refined finishes, while the workspaces are thoughtfully crafted to create a calm, welcoming atmosphere and an inspiring setting for business leaders.

##### Location description and benefits

Barsha Heights is a vibrant and well-connected community in Dubai, offering residents a dynamic urban lifestyle with a comfortable mix of residential towers, cafés, restaurants, shops, and everyday services. Its central position near Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai Internet City, and Media City makes it an excellent choice for those who value convenience and easy access to the city’s key destinations.

The area provides everything residents need close to home, from supermarkets, pharmacies, clinics, gyms, and salons to a wide variety of dining and leisure options. Green spaces, landscaped walkways, and nearby parks add a pleasant outdoor element, creating opportunities for walking, jogging, relaxation, and enjoying time with family and friends.

Excellent connectivity is one of Barsha Heights’ greatest advantages, with Dubai Internet City Metro Station nearby and direct access to major roads connecting residents to Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and other important districts. With its lively atmosphere, practical amenities, diverse community, and convenient location, Barsha Heights offers a highly enjoyable and well-balanced setting for modern city living.
